_purpose: Bounds and forbidden patterns for the Module 109 Reflector. Edit here to tune how aggressive auto-curation of USER.md / MEMORY.md is. 109 reads these at startup; runtime enforces them when applying proposals. Hermes's LLM-as-curator has no equivalent layer — this is the part Hermes cannot replicate without rewriting their architecture.

bounded_delta._doc: Per-task budget. The reflector may propose at most this many entries per file, and each entry is capped at the char limit. Net delta to USER.md/MEMORY.md per task is also capped to keep memory drift small and reviewable.

min_task_signal._doc: The reflector will NOT propose updates for trivial tasks. A task must clear these bars to be worth remembering. Prevents memory pollution from one-off chit-chat AND from failed tasks that an over-eager reflector would otherwise record as 'BLUE route effective' lessons.

forbidden_patterns._doc: Regex patterns (case-insensitive) that cause the proposal to be rejected even at high confidence. Covers PII the user did not explicitly opt into, credentials, and patterns that look like prompt-injection planted via memory.

forbidden_topics._doc: Substrings (case-insensitive) the user has explicitly asked be forgotten. The runtime appends to this list when the user says 'forget that' or similar; the reflector also reads it and refuses to remember anything matching.

rate_limits._doc: Soft caps to prevent runaway memory growth. If the agent has already learned a lot recently, slow down.
